title: Teacher creates Class & generates Class Code
user_visible_behavior: so that students can easily join the class using a 6-character code
verification_command: Teacher creates class in UI and receives a 6-character code
evidence: ClassroomService generates unique 6-character code, JPA persists to DB, REST endpoint tested

title: Student joins Class via Class Code
user_visible_behavior: so that student can see assignments given by their teacher
verification_command: Student enters valid code and is listed in teacher's class roster
evidence: ClassEnrollment saved, duplicate join prevented, student enrolled class list verified

title: Teacher creates Assignment with Parametric Bounds
user_visible_behavior: so that each student gets a personalized lab problem variant
verification_command: Assignment saved and students view personalized parameter values
evidence: Assignment entity saved, StudentAssignmentInstance generates reproducible random parameters per student

title: Student performs Lab experiment and submits answers
user_visible_behavior: so that student work can be graded by AI & Math engine
verification_command: Student submits answers and receives real-time grade feedback
evidence: StudentLabAssignmentView renders PhET lab + submission form + instant grade result modal

title: System grades submissions using Math Engine + Groq AI
user_visible_behavior: so that grades are accurate, fair, and accompanied by AI feedback
verification_command: Submission scored automatically with math breakdown and Groq AI review
evidence: JUnit MathVerificationEngineTest passed with 0 failures, GroqAIService Llama-3 JSON parser verified

title: Teacher views Class Gradebook and Roster Results
user_visible_behavior: so that teacher can monitor student progress and AI feedback
verification_command: Teacher dashboard displays student roster with score inspection drawer
evidence: ClassRosterView renders student table, scores (Math, AI, Total), and detailed Groq AI feedback drawer

title: Toast notification on Class Join and Duplicate Join warning
user_visible_behavior: so that student gets instant toast feedback and duplicate joins are blocked with explicit warning
verification_command: Joining shows green toast, re-joining shows warning toast 'Bạn đã tham gia lớp học này từ trước!'

title: Clicking Class card opens Class Assignments list
user_visible_behavior: so that student can click a class card and transition directly into lab assignments
verification_command: Clicking enrolled class card navigates to /student-assignments?classId=...
